chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mansur ibn Hazim who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who performed Tawaf between al-Safa and al-Marwa before he performed Tawaf by the House, so he (peace be upon him) said: 'He should perform Tawaf by the House, then return to al-Safa and al-Marwa and perform Tawaf between them.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a pilgrim performs Sa'i before Tawaf?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi clarifies the procedural validity of Sa'i when performed out of sequence, with Imam al-Sadiq (AS) ruling that the initial Sa'i is not nullified but requires the pilgrim to complete the Tawaf al-Ifadah first before repeating the Sa'i. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on the sequential integrity of Hajj pillars while maintaining the validity of individual acts performed with sincerity. It reflects the broader scholarly principle that minor deviations in ritual order do not invalidate the worship but require correction to achieve perfection.
